id: 37_What safety equipment is used at each BSL Biosafety Levels BSL-1 to BSL-4 trendi
title: 各生物安全等级使用哪些安全设备？
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/37_What safety equipment is used at each BSL Biosafety Levels BSL-1 to BSL-4 trendi.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/37_What safety equipment is used at each BSL Biosafety Levels BSL-1 to BSL-4 trendi/src.py

points.K1: 生物安全：护人、护环境、防外泄
points.K2: 等级决定程序、设备和设施
points.K3: 三类措施：个人防护、工程控制、设施
points.K4: 一套个人防护装备，从头到脚
points.K5: 一级个人防护：实验服为主
points.K6: 一级：洗手池、消毒用品、普通实验室
points.K7: 二级个人防护：加面部防护和闭趾鞋
points.K8: 二级工程控制：气溶胶操作进安全柜
points.K9: 二级设施：自闭门、洗眼器、灭菌器
points.K10: 三级个人防护：加呼吸防护
points.K11: 三级工程控制：必用安全柜，离心要密封
points.K12: 三级设施：负压、过滤、两道门
points.K13: 四级个人防护：正压防护服
points.K14: 四级工程控制：全密闭柜，独立供气
points.K15: 四级设施：独立隔离，层层去污

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排装备架前，架上有实验服、面屏、防护服
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an equipment rack holding a lab coat, a face shield and a protective suit, and waves.
shots.narration: 每一级实验室，要配哪些安全装备？
overlay: 每一级实验室，配哪些安全装备

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 四色生物危害标志下各放一组装备图标
shots.prompt_en: Four biohazard warning signs from pale yellow to deep red, each above a growing group of equipment icons. No people.
shots.narration: 今天从一级一直看到四级。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰换到二级实验室，只穿着实验服就要进门
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing only a lab coat, is about to enter a lab door with an orange biohazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 阿杰调到新实验室，照老习惯就要进门。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研在门口拦住他，指着墙上的空白装备清单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him at the door and points to a blank equipment checklist on the wall.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：这里级别不一样。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 两人站在一张空白三栏表前
shots.prompt_en: The two students stand in front of a blank three-column table.
shots.narration: 不同级别，装备差别可不小。

shots.section_title: 生物安全：护人、护环境、防外泄
shots.scene: 生物危害标志在中间，四周是人、树、城市图标
shots.prompt_en: A biohazard warning sign at the center, surrounded by icons of a person, a tree and a city. No people.
shots.narration: 先说生物安全的目的：
overlay: 生物安全：护人、护环境、防外泄

shots.section_title: 生物安全：护人、护环境、防外泄
shots.scene: 病菌被挡在人形图标和门外
shots.prompt_en: A germ icon blocked by a shield before a person icon and before a lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 防实验室感染，防病原外泄。

shots.section_title: 等级决定程序、设备和设施
shots.scene: 四级台阶，每级连着程序、设备、设施三个小图标
shots.prompt_en: A four-step staircase; each step is linked to three small icons: a procedure binder, a cabinet and a building. No people.
shots.narration: 危害越高，等级越高，
overlay: 等级决定程序、设备和设施

shots.section_title: 等级决定程序、设备和设施
shots.scene: 台阶越往上，图标越多越大
shots.prompt_en: Higher steps carry more and larger icons. No people.
shots.narration: 程序、设备和设施的要求就越严。

shots.section_title: 三类措施：个人防护、工程控制、设施
shots.scene: 三栏表头：人形、安全柜、建筑
shots.prompt_en: A table header with three columns marked by icons: a person in protective gear, a biological safety cabinet, and a building. No people.
shots.narration: 每一级的措施，分三栏来看：
overlay: 三类措施：个人防护、工程控制、设施

shots.section_title: 三类措施：个人防护、工程控制、设施
shots.scene: 人形图标、安全柜气流、房间示意依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The three icons light up in turn: protective gear on a person, airflow in a cabinet, a room plan. No people.
shots.narration: 穿什么，用什么设备，房子怎么建。

shots.section_title: 一套个人防护装备，从头到脚
shots.scene: 小研对着镜子穿戴防护，从头到脚
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands at a mirror in a changing area, dressed from head to toe in protective gear.
shots.narration: 先认一认全套个人防护装备：
overlay: 一套个人防护装备，从头到脚

shots.section_title: 一套个人防护装备，从头到脚
shots.scene: 头套、护目镜、口罩三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a head cover, goggles and a fitted mask. No people.
shots.narration: 头套、护目镜或面屏、密合的口罩，

shots.section_title: 一套个人防护装备，从头到脚
shots.scene: 隔离衣、手套、鞋套三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an isolation gown, disposable gloves and shoe covers. No people.
shots.narration: 隔离衣、一次性手套、鞋套或闭趾鞋。

shots.section_title: 一套个人防护装备，从头到脚
shots.scene: 带生物危害标志的黄色废物袋
shots.prompt_en: A yellow waste bag with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的，放进感染性废物袋。

shots.section_title: 一级个人防护：实验服为主
shots.scene: 表格一级行亮起，个人防护栏是实验服
shots.prompt_en: The first row of the table lights up; the protective gear column shows a lab coat icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一级，个人防护以实验服为主，
overlay: 一级个人防护：实验服为主

shots.section_title: 一级个人防护：实验服为主
shots.scene: 阿杰穿实验服，旁边有手套和护目镜图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears a lab coat; icons of gloves and goggles float beside him.
shots.narration: 需要时戴手套，护目镜可选。

shots.section_title: 一级：洗手池、消毒用品、普通实验室
shots.scene: 洗手池和消毒喷壶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a hand-washing sink and a disinfectant spray bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 工程控制：洗手池和基本消毒用品。
overlay: 一级：洗手池、消毒用品、普通实验室

shots.section_title: 一级：洗手池、消毒用品、普通实验室
shots.scene: 普通开放实验台
shots.prompt_en: An ordinary open lab bench in a bright room. No people.
shots.narration: 设施：普通开放实验室就行。

shots.section_title: 二级个人防护：加面部防护和闭趾鞋
shots.scene: 表格二级行亮起，个人防护栏多了面屏和鞋
shots.prompt_en: The second row lights up; the protective gear column now shows a lab coat, gloves, goggles, a face shield and closed-toe shoes. No people.
shots.narration: 二级，个人防护加码：
overlay: 二级个人防护：加面部防护和闭趾鞋

shots.section_title: 二级个人防护：加面部防护和闭趾鞋
shots.scene: 小研戴手套、护目镜，穿闭趾鞋
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a lab coat, gloves, goggles and closed-toe shoes.
shots.narration: 实验服、手套、护目镜或面屏，

shots.section_title: 二级个人防护：加面部防护和闭趾鞋
shots.scene: 露脚趾的凉鞋图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of open-toe sandals crossed out with a red X next to closed-toe shoes with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 必须穿闭趾鞋。

shots.section_title: 二级工程控制：气溶胶操作进安全柜
shots.scene: 生物安全柜，前窗有气流箭头
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet with airflow arrows at the front opening. No people.
shots.narration: 工程控制：二级生物安全柜。
overlay: 二级工程控制：气溶胶操作进安全柜

shots.section_title: 二级工程控制：气溶胶操作进安全柜
shots.scene: 小研在安全柜里打开振荡后的管子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a mixed tube inside a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 可能产生气溶胶的操作，放进柜里做。

shots.section_title: 二级设施：自闭门、洗眼器、灭菌器
shots.scene: 门在身后自动关上
shots.prompt_en: A lab door with a door closer swings shut by itself. No people.
shots.narration: 设施：门能自动关闭，
overlay: 二级设施：自闭门、洗眼器、灭菌器

shots.section_title: 二级设施：自闭门、洗眼器、灭菌器
shots.scene: 墙上的洗眼器和洗眼标志
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash station on the wall with an eyewash sign. No people.
shots.narration: 有洗眼装置，

shots.section_title: 二级设施：自闭门、洗眼器、灭菌器
shots.scene: 实验室里的高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: An autoclave inside the lab. No people.
shots.narration: 还要有高压灭菌器可用。

shots.section_title: 三级个人防护：加呼吸防护
shots.scene: 表格三级行亮起，个人防护栏多了呼吸防护
shots.prompt_en: The third row lights up; the protective gear column shows a solid-front gown, gloves, goggles and a respirator. No people.
shots.narration: 三级，防护再升一级：
overlay: 三级个人防护：加呼吸防护

shots.section_title: 三级个人防护：加呼吸防护
shots.scene: 前襟封闭的防护服和普通实验服对比
shots.prompt_en: A solid-front protective gown next to an ordinary front-buttoned lab coat. No people.
shots.narration: 穿前襟封闭的防护服，戴手套和护目，

shots.section_title: 三级个人防护：加呼吸防护
shots.scene: N95口罩和动力送风呼吸器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an N95 respirator mask and a powered air-purifying respirator. No people.
shots.narration: 加戴呼吸防护，比如N95或送风呼吸器。

shots.section_title: 三级工程控制：必用安全柜，离心要密封
shots.scene: 生物安全柜和全密闭的手套箱式安全柜
shots.prompt_en: An open-front biological safety cabinet next to a fully enclosed glove-box cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 工程控制：必用Ⅱ级或Ⅲ级安全柜，
overlay: 三级工程控制：必用安全柜，离心要密封

shots.section_title: 三级工程控制：必用安全柜，离心要密封
shots.scene: 带密封盖的离心杯
shots.prompt_en: A centrifuge cup with a sealed lid. No people.
shots.narration: 离心用密封的离心杯。

shots.section_title: 三级设施：负压、过滤、两道门
shots.scene: 房间示意图，空气箭头只往里走
shots.prompt_en: A room diagram with airflow arrows only pointing inward. No people.
shots.narration: 设施：负压，空气只进不出，
overlay: 三级设施：负压、过滤、两道门

shots.section_title: 三级设施：负压、过滤、两道门
shots.scene: 排风口上的过滤器图标
shots.prompt_en: An exhaust duct with a filter icon. No people.
shots.narration: 排风经过高效过滤，

shots.section_title: 三级设施：负压、过滤、两道门
shots.scene: 两道自闭门和中间的小间
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of two self-closing doors in a row with a small room between them. No people.
shots.narration: 进出要过两道自闭门，

shots.section_title: 三级设施：负压、过滤、两道门
shots.scene: 感应式洗手池和洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: A hands-free sensor sink next to an eyewash station. No people.
shots.narration: 洗手池免手动，旁边有洗眼器。

shots.section_title: 四级个人防护：正压防护服
shots.scene: 表格四级行亮起，个人防护栏是正压防护服
shots.prompt_en: The fourth row lights up; the protective gear column shows a full-body suit. No people.
shots.narration: 四级，防护到顶。
overlay: 四级个人防护：正压防护服

shots.section_title: 四级个人防护：正压防护服
shots.scene: 连着供气管的正压防护服图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a full-body positive-pressure suit connected to an air hose. No people.
shots.narration: 不用全密闭柜时，穿正压供气防护服，

shots.section_title: 四级个人防护：正压防护服
shots.scene: 两层手套的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand wearing two layers of gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 手上戴多层手套。

shots.section_title: 四级工程控制：全密闭柜，独立供气
shots.scene: 全密闭的手套箱式安全柜
shots.prompt_en: A fully enclosed glove-box cabinet with arm ports. No people.
shots.narration: 工程控制：全密闭的三级安全柜，
overlay: 四级工程控制：全密闭柜，独立供气

shots.section_title: 四级工程控制：全密闭柜，独立供气
shots.scene: 防护服实验室里的二级安全柜和供气管
shots.prompt_en: A suit-lab room with an open-front biological safety cabinet and air hoses hanging from the ceiling. No people.
shots.narration: 或防护服实验室配二级安全柜，独立供气。

shots.section_title: 四级设施：独立隔离，层层去污
shots.scene: 被几层墙包围的独立建筑
shots.prompt_en: An isolated building surrounded by several walls. No people.
shots.narration: 设施：独立建筑或隔离区，
overlay: 四级设施：独立隔离，层层去污

shots.section_title: 四级设施：独立隔离，层层去污
shots.scene: 气锁门和去污淋浴图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an airlock door and a decontamination shower. No people.
shots.narration: 气锁进入，出来要去污淋浴，

shots.section_title: 四级设施：独立隔离，层层去污
shots.scene: 进风、排风两端都有过滤器
shots.prompt_en: A diagram with filter icons on both the air supply and the exhaust. No people.
shots.narration: 进风排风都经高效过滤，

shots.section_title: 四级设施：独立隔离，层层去污
shots.scene: 应急发电机和对讲机图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a backup generator and an intercom. No people.
shots.narration: 还要有应急电源和通讯系统。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣站在四行三栏的大表前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a large table with four rows and three columns.
shots.narration: 每一级都看三栏：

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 实验服、安全柜、开放实验室依次升级成防护服、密闭柜、隔离建筑
shots.prompt_en: Icons upgrade step by step: a lab coat becomes a full suit, an open cabinet becomes a sealed cabinet, an open lab becomes an isolated building. No people.
shots.narration: 穿的、用的、建的，一级比一级严。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣穿好全套防护，在门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, wearing a lab coat, goggles and gloves, waves goodbye at a lab door.
shots.narration: 装备齐了再开工，下次见！
